strategy_notation: Preserves original 67 if conditions, 9 ranking filters, weighting/thresholds. Replaces source GDXU with SOXL and source GDXD with SOXS in BOTH holdings and signals, plus thematic V2 substitutions.

execution.signals: All conditions use prices through close t
execution.entry: At next trading day's closing price t+1
execution.returns: From close t+1 to close t+2

external_allocation_overlay.market_regime: SPY close vs 200-day simple moving average, computed through signal day t

reported_simulation.performance_status: Retrospective, selected in sample; not forward-validated, not independently verified Composer parity
